MOHAMMAD HASNAIN

TEAM LEAD – FUND ACCOUNTING & ADMINISTRATION

Trade Processing | Trade Lifecycle | NAV Operations | Fund Administration

Pune, Maharashtra, India | +91 9718259927 | Hasnainss0820@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Fund Accounting and Investment Operations professional with 10+ years of experience across Private Equity, Hedge Fund and Investment Operations, specializing in Fund Accounting, Fund Administration, NAV Calculation, Trade Processing, Trade Lifecycle Management, Reconciliation, Fund Valuation and Financial Reporting. Experienced in multi-strategy portfolios covering Equities, Fixed Income, FX and Derivatives, with exposure across trade capture, validation, booking, settlement-related activities, break investigation and downstream NAV impact. Strong experience in management and performance fee calculations, cash and position reconciliation, corporate actions, capital calls, distributions and investor reporting. Proven ability to coordinate with custodians, brokers, clients and internal stakeholders to resolve operational exceptions and deliver within SLA.

CORE SKILLS

Fund Accounting & Fund Administration • NAV Calculation & Validation • End-to-End Trade Lifecycle • Trade Capture, Processing & Validation • Trade Booking & Reconciliation • Trade Settlement & Post-Trade Operations • Cash & Position Reconciliation • STP Break Investigation & Resolution • ETD / Futures • OTC Derivatives • Equities, Fixed Income & FX • Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI) • Management & Performance Fees • Fund Valuation & Pricing • Corporate Actions • Capital Calls & Distributions • Waterfall Calculations • Client & Stakeholder Management • Operational Controls & SLA Management

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

STATE STREET Team Lead – Fund Accounting & Administration | May 2022 – Present | Bengaluru / Pune, India

Managed the end-to-end trade lifecycle for Private Equity and Hedge Fund portfolios, starting from receipt of executed trades from brokers through trade capture, trade-attribute validation, affirmation/matching, settlement monitoring, Prime Broker/custodian reconciliation, pricing and final NAV release. Received executed trades from brokers through E-Horizon or email, reviewed the trade details and captured the transactions in the relevant processing/accounting system for downstream fund accounting and NAV processing. Performed detailed trade capture and validation by checking fund and account details, buy/sell indicator, security and ISIN, quantity, price, trade date, settlement date, currency, broker and other relevant trade attributes before the trade proceeded through the downstream workflow. Performed trade affirmation and broker matching after validation to ensure the trade attributes were complete and accurate. Where trades were missing, mismatched or contained incorrect information, coordinated with the broker and relevant stakeholders to obtain corrections before fund pricing.







Monitored contractual settlement dates during trade processing and investigated settlement exceptions, including cases involving pending client payments or incorrect/missing trade-date updates, coordinating with the appropriate stakeholders to avoid or resolve failed trades.

Coordinated with brokers, custodians, Prime Brokers and Investment Managers throughout the trade lifecycle to resolve









trade discrepancies, confirm transaction details and ensure accurate portfolio records and timely NAV delivery. Performed trade, cash and position reconciliation against Prime Broker and custodian records; investigated breaks and coordinated with brokers, Prime Brokers and internal teams to ensure timely resolution before NAV finalization. Supported trade settlement and post-trade processing through custodian records, ensuring settled transactions were accurately reflected in the fund accounting books, portfolio positions and downstream NAV calculations. Performed pre-processing checks on trade data to identify missing, incomplete or mismatched trade attributes before downstream processing, helping reduce trade-processing and reconciliation exceptions. Investigated and resolved trade-processing, cash and position breaks, identifying discrepancies between internal books, broker/Prime Broker and custodian records and following up with the relevant parties until resolution.

Managed investment transactions across equities, fixed income, FX, ETD/Futures and OTC derivatives as part of multi-

strategy fund accounting and valuation activities.

Mohammad Hasnain | Fund Accounting & Trade Operations

• Maintained and validated Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI) used in the trade and settlement workflow and

coordinated with relevant stakeholders where settlement information required correction.

Utilized TLM for reconciliation and exception-management activities, investigating trade, cash and position discrepancies

and coordinating with relevant teams for timely break resolution.

Worked with E-Horizon, MCH, Bloomberg, Eagle and Charles River Investment System across trade processing, fund

accounting, reconciliation, investment data and valuation activities.

Maintained exposure to SWIFT messaging workflows, including MT564 (Corporate Action Notification), MT565 (Corporate Action Instruction), MT566 (Corporate Action Confirmation), MT536 and MT940, with an understanding of their role in corporate actions, cash reporting and post-trade processing.

Gained exposure to CCP-based clearing processes and complex derivative products, including Cross-Currency Swaps

(CCS), within the broader trade-processing and fund accounting environment.

Coordinated with the Security Valuation/Pricing team to resolve pricing-related issues and ensure required valuation

checks were completed before final NAV release.

Calculated, booked and reviewed management fees, performance/incentive fees, carried interest and other fund-





related expenses, ensuring accurate accounting and appropriate NAV impact. Prepared and reviewed daily and monthly NAV calculations, incorporating trade, pricing, reconciliation, fee and expense inputs and completing required control checks before NAV release. Led the fund accounting team, performing quality reviews, SLA monitoring, stakeholder coordination and escalation management to ensure accurate and timely client deliverables.

BNY MELLON Senior Representative – Fund Accounting & Administration | July 2019 – May 2022 | Chennai, India

Managed fund accounting activities across Hedge Funds and Mutual Funds, including daily trade activity, cash journals and

portfolio positions.

Reviewed and finalized NAV calculations for hedge funds involving derivatives, equities and fixed income securities.

Managed fund accounting activities covering pricing, accruals, reconciliation and financial reporting.

Validated corporate actions including dividends, stock splits and mergers.

Coordinated with custodians, brokers and internal teams to investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks.

Handled client queries, audit deliverables and financial reporting requirements.

MPHASIS LTD Knowledge Specialist – Fund Administration | April 2017 – January 2019 | Pune, India

Maintained daily trade activity, cash journals and portfolio positions.

Validated corporate actions including dividends, stock splits and mergers.

Reconciled trades, cash and NAV with prime broker records.

Prepared transaction, valuation and portfolio reports and handled client requests.

Performed blotter reconciliation.

STATE STREET Performance Measurement Analyst – US PNA | November 2014 – March 2017 | Pune, India

Calculated daily, monthly, quarterly and yearly portfolio returns in accordance with GIPS standards.

Performed portfolio and benchmark reconciliation and investigated security-level discrepancies.

Investigated transaction, position and pricing discrepancies and coordinated resolution with relevant teams.

Prepared performance reporting using Time Weighted Rate of Return (TWRR) and Money Weighted Rate of Return (MWR).

Performed performance attribution and portfolio analysis.

EDUCATION

Master of Business Administration (MBA) – Lucknow University | 2014

Bachelor of Business Management (BBM) – Bangalore University | 2012

AWARDS & RECOGNITION

Syntel Champ – State Street Syntel Services

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
STATE STREET Team Lead – Fund Accounting & Administration | May 2022 – Present | Bengaluru / Pune, India
Managed the end-to-end trade lifecycle for Private Equity and Hedge Fund portfolios, starting from receipt of executed trades from brokers through trade capture, trade-attribute validation, affirmation/matching, settlement monitoring, Prime Broker/custodian reconciliation, pricing and final NAV release. Received executed trades from brokers through E-Horizon or email, reviewed the trade details and captured the transactions in the relevant processing/accounting system for downstream fund accounting and NAV processing. Performed detailed trade capture and validation by checking fund and account details, buy/sell indicator, security and ISIN, quantity, price, trade date, settlement date, currency, broker and other relevant trade attributes before the trade proceeded through the downstream workflow. Performed trade affirmation and broker matching after validation to ensure the trade attributes were complete and accurate. Where trades were missing, mismatched or contained incorrect information, coordinated with the broker and relevant stakeholders to obtain corrections before fund pricing.



Monitored contractual settlement dates during trade processing and investigated settlement exceptions, including cases involving pending client payments or incorrect/missing trade-date updates, coordinating with the appropriate stakeholders to avoid or resolve failed trades.
Coordinated with brokers, custodians, Prime Brokers and Investment Managers throughout the trade lifecycle to resolve




trade discrepancies, confirm transaction details and ensure accurate portfolio records and timely NAV delivery. Performed trade, cash and position reconciliation against Prime Broker and custodian records; investigated breaks and coordinated with brokers, Prime Brokers and internal teams to ensure timely resolution before NAV finalization. Supported trade settlement and post-trade processing through custodian records, ensuring settled transactions were accurately reflected in the fund accounting books, portfolio positions and downstream NAV calculations. Performed pre-processing checks on trade data to identify missing, incomplete or mismatched trade attributes before downstream processing, helping reduce trade-processing and reconciliation exceptions. Investigated and resolved trade-processing, cash and position breaks, identifying discrepancies between internal books, broker/Prime Broker and custodian records and following up with the relevant parties until resolution.
Managed investment transactions across equities, fixed income, FX, ETD/Futures and OTC derivatives as part of multi-
strategy fund accounting and valuation activities.
Mohammad Hasnain | Fund Accounting & Trade Operations
• Maintained and validated Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI) used in the trade and settlement workflow and
coordinated with relevant stakeholders where settlement information required correction.
Utilized TLM for reconciliation and exception-management activities, investigating trade, cash and position discrepancies
and coordinating with relevant teams for timely break resolution.
Worked with E-Horizon, MCH, Bloomberg, Eagle and Charles River Investment System across trade processing, fund
accounting, reconciliation, investment data and valuation activities.
Maintained exposure to SWIFT messaging workflows, including MT564 (Corporate Action Notification), MT565 (Corporate Action Instruction), MT566 (Corporate Action Confirmation), MT536 and MT940, with an understanding of their role in corporate actions, cash reporting and post-trade processing.
Gained exposure to CCP-based clearing processes and complex derivative products, including Cross-Currency Swaps
(CCS), within the broader trade-processing and fund accounting environment.
Coordinated with the Security Valuation/Pricing team to resolve pricing-related issues and ensure required valuation
checks were completed before final NAV release.
Calculated, booked and reviewed management fees, performance/incentive fees, carried interest and other fund-


related expenses, ensuring accurate accounting and appropriate NAV impact. Prepared and reviewed daily and monthly NAV calculations, incorporating trade, pricing, reconciliation, fee and expense inputs and completing required control checks before NAV release. Led the fund accounting team, performing quality reviews, SLA monitoring, stakeholder coordination and escalation management to ensure accurate and timely client deliverables.
BNY MELLON Senior Representative – Fund Accounting & Administration | July 2019 – May 2022 | Chennai, India
Managed fund accounting activities across Hedge Funds and Mutual Funds, including daily trade activity, cash journals and
portfolio positions.
Reviewed and finalized NAV calculations for hedge funds involving derivatives, equities and fixed income securities.
Managed fund accounting activities covering pricing, accruals, reconciliation and financial reporting.
Validated corporate actions including dividends, stock splits and mergers.
Coordinated with custodians, brokers and internal teams to investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks.
Handled client queries, audit deliverables and financial reporting requirements.
MPHASIS LTD Knowledge Specialist – Fund Administration | April 2017 – January 2019 | Pune, India
Maintained daily trade activity, cash journals and portfolio positions.
Validated corporate actions including dividends, stock splits and mergers.
Reconciled trades, cash and NAV with prime broker records.
Prepared transaction, valuation and portfolio reports and handled client requests.
Performed blotter reconciliation.
STATE STREET Performance Measurement Analyst – US PNA | November 2014 – March 2017 | Pune, India
Calculated daily, monthly, quarterly and yearly portfolio returns in accordance with GIPS standards.
Performed portfolio and benchmark reconciliation and investigated security-level discrepancies.
Investigated transaction, position and pricing discrepancies and coordinated resolution with relevant teams.
Prepared performance reporting using Time Weighted Rate of Return (TWRR) and Money Weighted Rate of Return (MWR).
Performed performance attribution and portfolio analysis.
